final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM address GROUP BY city_id), avg_cnt AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count FROM city_counts WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), with_avg AS (SELECT c.city_id, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / a.avg_count AS ratio_avg FROM city_counts c JOIN avg_cnt a ON a.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE c.cnt IS NOT NULL), total_cnt AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM with_avg WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), final AS (SELECT w.city_id, w.cnt, w.ratio_avg, CAST(w.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio_total FROM with_avg w JOIN total_cnt t ON t.total IS NOT NULL) SELECT city_id, cnt, ratio_avg, ratio_total FROM final ORDER BY ratio_total DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
